decisions: activity template object links are stored once and reused
real activity event remains one physical event row
process_count=1 is mandatory for every linked observation object
repetition_count, distance_m and duration_seconds are optional routed parameters
parameter routing uses only controlled aggregation codes
profile versions are immutable snapshots for events
virtual contributions are query-time projections, not physical fact fan-out
existing value_object_analytics_profiles_v1 is reused for dynamic state settings
virtual-to-current-state runtime integration is deferred until event-level deduplication prevents double counting
v2_fix: Move short-query searchResults reset from synchronous useEffect body to input event handler; effect exits without setState.
